angular.scope: isotropic source quadrature instantaneously, not full absorption trajectory. Reference-mu map fixed in time, positive weights.

source_only.scope: same actual source energy history integrated without any absorption, so not coupled J2 prediction

recross.scope: source born above threshold, later below and then above; unabsorbed characteristic count is a potential upper bound for the same prescribed birth history, not actual surviving count. Sampling is not continuum certified.
